name: PAN-OS — High-Severity Threat Allowed Through the Perimeter
description: Promotes only actionable Palo Alto threat events: high/critical IPS or spyware signatures whose session was ALLOWED (not blocked). Replaces the deleted catch-all External Alerts rule (which promoted 550k+ PAN-OS events/day) with a scoped, low-volume signal for threats that got through.
author: JCB Detection Engineering
query: event.dataset:"panw.panos" and panw.panos.sub_type:(vulnerability or spyware) and panw.panos.action:(alert or allow) and event.severity <= 2
